source: S5 D1 call-site map (AUDITOR-MODEL 2026-10-17: every evaluatePolicy call site mapped or explicitly excluded); lane a55/s5 2026-10-23, base b10f46ae

classes.sealed: deny and require-approval reach a sealed audit event of the named kind
classes.partial: some refusal outcomes are sealed, the note names the rest
classes.pure: a probe or helper; the named caller makes the real decision, or a display that never gates an effect
classes.read-gate: authorizes a read only; a refusal is an error with no effect to record
classes.unsealed: gates an effect but a refusal leaves no sealed audit record (open; later D1 slices)
classes.unsure: classification needs the owning slice's review

src/domain/core/identity-profile/interna.note: draft before/after diff preview, no writer

src/domain/core/policy/internal/administ.note: admin capability probe; POLICY_LAST_ADMIN refusal sealed as authority-refusal (best-effort)

src/domain/core/policy/internal/decision.note: explicit decision grant probe for approval/runs callers

src/domain/core/policy/internal/mode.ts.note: full-access / full-auto grant probes; full-access-turn sealed incl. deny

src/domain/core/policy/internal/owner-ba.note: owner-baseline before/after policy probes; no I/O; installation/owner-baseline conditionally publishes the plan with authority-change audit and archive

src/engine/core/agent-catalog/internal/a.note: agent-catalog define/import gate (S7); an allowed transition is sealed as agent-catalog, a refusal is not yet; inspect is a read-gate

src/engine/core/approval/internal/admiss.note: task/execute admission; require-approval opens an approval request only

src/engine/core/approval/internal/applic.note: approval decide/renew refusals; inspect is a read-gate

src/engine/core/approval/internal/templa.note: pre-checks and lockout probes before administerOwnPolicyChange

src/engine/core/config/internal/policy.t.note: only allow sealed (config-change); require-approval opens a config-change approval

src/engine/core/decision/internal/author.note: decision port actions; inspect is a read-gate

src/engine/core/effect/internal/applicat.note: sealed only for policy.administer; other operations leave an effect-store refused record

src/engine/core/hub-operations/internal/.note: hub search/install/publish/yank/revoke grant; a refusal throws a typed policy error with no sealed audit record, an allow carries ruleId and revision into the client receipt

src/engine/core/installation/internal/ap.note: checks an authored profile's policy (profile validation or gate)

src/engine/core/memory/internal/authoriz.note: memory propose/verify/retire gate (S4); an allowed transition is sealed as memory-journal, a refusal is not yet; inspect is a read-gate; the S4B-1 read filter (source read-output and work-target use) only withholds entries from an answer (read-gate, no effect)

src/engine/core/nervous/internal/broker..note: S6R-3 owner standing grant (recovery-action/apply): no grant seals the case proposal-only, a grant seals execute with standingRef; alpha.56 rule promotion (nervous-rule/promote) is sealed as the rule status of the same record

src/engine/core/recovery/internal/policy.note: alpha.56: card display of the effective grant; the change goes through administerOwnPolicyChange (policy.administer)

src/engine/core/recovery/internal/approv.note: S6R-4 owner standing grant (recovery-action/apply continue-new-attempt): no grant refuses the continuation (nothing written), a grant is sealed as decisionRuleId on the continue-lost-task event

src/engine/core/policy/internal/agent-to.note: tool-list exposure is a filter; revalidation after an approved card is noted in policy-turn (stage effect)

src/engine/core/policy/internal/authoriz.note: attempt actions; scope/inspect is a read-gate

src/engine/core/policy/internal/permissi.note: agent tool call decisions incl. shell write-set entries: refusals (policy/cell/effect stage) and plain allows in policy-turn; relaxations keep their own events; MCP-proposal tool calls (proposals.apply) are not noted as allows

src/engine/core/policy/internal/pool.ts.note: hold/resume/capacity/quota sealed; pool/use at reservation unsealed

src/engine/core/policy/internal/run.ts.note: run cancel/reserve; inspect is a read-gate

src/engine/core/runs/internal/authority..note: run/create sealed; proposal require-approval deferred to task admission
